description: Org preset. Every repo: { "extends": ["github>JakobMelchard/.github//renovate/default"] }. Public here so private and public consumers read the same file.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Fix PRs for Dependabot (and OSV) alerts. Dependabot security updates are off org-wide (infra), so these are the only fix PRs. Explicit schedule: they skip schedule:weekly. baseBranchPatterns per repo still applies.

packageRules.description: npm releases get a longer quarantine: registry compromises are usually caught within days.
Actions minutes are scarce: at most one weekly PR per repo for automergeable updates and one for minors. Named groups below still win for their packages; majors stay separate.
Hook revs in .pre-commit-config.yaml (prek): one PR per repo.

Low-risk updates merge on their own once CI is green. Renovate's own automerge, not GitHub's: native auto-merge needs branch protection, which the free plan does not enforce on private repos. A repo with no passing check never automerges. Kept above the automerge: false exceptions below, since later rules win.
devDependencies never ship to prod: minor and patch automerge once CI is green. Majors stay manual.
GitHub Actions: minor, patch and digest automerge once CI is green. Majors stay manual.
Docker images: never automerge, digest and patch included. Kept after the automerge rules above, since later rules win.
setup-gradle v6+ must keep cache-provider: basic (the default caching is proprietary); a major bump needs review, never automerge.
Template updates (copier, JakobMelchard/template) can touch CI, hooks and configs at once: review, never automerge.
Our own reusable workflows are consumed at @main on purpose; never digest-pin them.
